label: Incheon foreign-child childcare subsidy
appliesTo: Foreign children aged 3 to 5 at a daycare centre in Incheon, with registered stay and over 90 days of residence in the jurisdiction. Undocumented or unregistered children are excluded, and under-3s fall outside the published age range.
why: A municipal budget programme, not a national entitlement — it stops at the city line, and the 90-day residence condition means a family that has just moved cannot assume it starts on arrival.

history.source: Incheon Metropolitan City — foreign-child childcare fee support
history.note: Same figure as the national ages 3–5 rate, and a different programme. Applied through the childcare centre.
